value.name: Waiting before retrying the pnpm download
value.run:
echo "::warning::pnpm-setup-retry=started. The first pnpm/setup attempt failed or hit its 2-minute bound; its error is in the Installing pnpm step. Retrying once in 20s."
sleep 20

value.name: Installing pnpm (retry after a failed download)
Recording the pnpm download retry result
value.run:
if [[ "$RETRY_OUTCOME" == success ]]; then
  echo "::notice::pnpm-setup-retry=recovered. The first pnpm/setup attempt failed and the retry installed pnpm."
else
  echo "::error::pnpm-setup-retry=exhausted retry=${RETRY_OUTCOME}. Both pnpm/setup attempts failed; their errors are in the two Installing pnpm steps."
fi

value.name: Ensure npm 11.5.1+ for OIDC support
value.run:
if npm install -g npm@11 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "npm upgraded via bundled npm"
else
  echo "::warning::Bundled npm broken, bootstrapping from tarball"
  NPM_VER=$(node -e "fetch('https://registry.npmjs.org/npm/next-11').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>console.log(d.version))")
  curl -fsSL "https://registry.npmjs.org/npm/-/npm-${NPM_VER}.tgz" | tar xz -C /tmp
  node /tmp/package/bin/npm-cli.js install -g "npm@${NPM_VER}"
  rm -rf /tmp/package
fi
echo "npm $(npm --version)"

value.name: Detect changesets
value.run:
count=$(find .changeset -maxdepth 1 -name '*.md' -not -name 'README.md' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
echo "count=$count" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "has_changesets=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "Found $count pending changeset(s). Agents-private owns Version Packages PR creation; skipping publish."
else
  echo "has_changesets=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No pending changesets; will attempt to publish any unreleased versions."
fi

value.name: Publish
value.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Provenance is required for npm Trusted Publishing attestations.
# This repo's @changesets/cli does not know a --provenance flag
# (that errored the first release run), so it goes through npm
# config instead — npm reads it when changesets shells out.
pnpm changeset publish | tee /tmp/publish.log

# Changesets emits "packages published successfully" after >=1
# package ships; a no-op run (nothing ahead of npm) does not.
if ! grep -q "packages published successfully" /tmp/publish.log; then
  echo "Nothing published — all package versions already on npm."
  exit 0
fi

# All @visimer/* packages share a version (fixed group in
# .changeset/config.json), so core's package.json is authoritative.
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version")

# Ground-truth check: verify every workspace package actually
# resolves on npm at VERSION before pushing tags. The registry
# read-path can lag the publish by seconds — retry with backoff.
MISSING=()
for pkg_json in packages/*/package.json; do
  PKG_NAME=$(node -p "require('./$pkg_json').name" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  IS_PRIVATE=$(node -p "require('./$pkg_json').private ?? false" 2>/dev/null || echo "false")
  [ -z "$PKG_NAME" ] && continue
  [ "$IS_PRIVATE" = "true" ] && continue
  FOUND=false
  for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
    if npm view "$PKG_NAME@$VERSION" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      FOUND=true
      break
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -lt 4 ]; then
      sleep $((attempt * 2))
    fi
  done
  if [ "$FOUND" = "false" ]; then
    MISSING+=("$PKG_NAME")
  fi
done

if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::Publish log reported success, but these packages are NOT on npm at v$VERSION after retries: ${MISSING[*]}"
  echo "::error::Likely a partial publish. Re-running this workflow is safe — changeset publish is idempotent."
  exit 1
fi

echo "All @visimer/* packages verified present on npm at v$VERSION."

# `changeset publish` created local tags (@visimer/core@X.Y.Z, ...);
# push them so the release is discoverable from the repo.
git push origin --tags

file_enhancements.explanation: Generated pnpm v9-format lockfile that pins the workspace's resolved dependency graph for reproducible installs.
file_enhancements.best_practice: Keep it committed, never edit it by hand, and run CI installs with --frozen-lockfile.
file_enhancements.security_concern: None seen in the three settings shown; the other ~2,550 entries were not visible. Lockfile changes can hide supply-chain edits, so review them and run pnpm audit in CI.
file_enhancements.context: Dependency pinning; autoInstallPeers is on, so peer dependencies are installed automatically and recorded here.

file_enhancements.explanation: Shared TypeScript compiler options inherited by the package tsconfigs, targeting ES2022 with ESNext modules and bundler resolution.
file_enhancements.best_practice: Bundler resolution can accept imports that fail under Node's ESM resolver, so validate the published packages with a tool such as publint or Are the Types Wrong.
file_enhancements.migration_suggestion: None; this is already the consolidation point for shared compiler options.

file_enhancements.explanation: Private root manifest for visimer-monorepo that pins the package manager to pnpm@12.8.1.

file_enhancements.migration_suggestion: Keep shared dev tooling and workspace scripts at the root rather than repeating them in each package.

file_enhancements.explanation: Defines the workspace as packages/* and apps/*, and relaxes package-manager and dependency-state checks through pmOnFail: ignore and verifyDepsBeforeRun: false.
file_enhancements.best_practice: Consider stricter values, such as verifyDepsBeforeRun: error or install, and a pmOnFail mode that reports mismatches, so stale dependencies and the wrong pnpm version are caught early. If the current values are intentional, document why.
file_enhancements.security_concern: None directly, but pmOnFail: ignore weakens enforcement of the packageManager pin, which reduces toolchain reproducibility.
file_enhancements.migration_suggestion: Consider pnpm catalogs here if packages share dependency version ranges; the shown settings don't confirm whether catalogs are already used.
